comments.value:
And... When Player notes reach 2000, existing notes cannot be updated. 

https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/when-player-notes-reach-2000-existing-notes-cannot-be-updated

It would be nice to be able to see the users you've already added notes to, so you're able to remove them from old players and add them to someone else. Or to be able to export notes as a file so you can update them locally, in one place.

@{62150f3a5441964463479e56|full_name}

The restriction was silently lifted, so this issue is essentially resolved. However, I think it would still be useful to have a feature that shows who added a note, so I hope that gets implemented.

@{5f3df2f75af9f322b0f66e1b|full_name}

Has it really been lifted? When I try to add notes to people on VRC and reopen their profile, the note disappears. When I try add a note on the website, I get the following error: """Player Notes

Update Player Notes Failed. You're not allowed to create more than 2099 user notesǃ """

Edit 16h later: The limit seems to be 2098 now?

@{62150f3a5441964463479e56|full_name} oh...

I created 2,000 notes, but probably not more than 2,099...

After I opened this issue, the 2,000-note limit was temporarily lifted, but it might have just been a simple increase in the upper limit. It seems like a good idea to ping them again.

https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/when-player-notes-reach-2000-existing-notes-cannot-be-updated
The biggest problem is not having a good way to remove stale or inconsequential ones. If I add a note to a rando I've seen twice and never again, how can I get that "note slot" back?
I was gonna say, why's there a limit to that, and then thought, well you can leave a note on your own profile, so why is that even an option?
Honestly though, you should be able to have as many notes as friends you can have, that would make sense.
I don't understand how you can have 2k people as "friends" and to wanna add notes to that many as well... ._.

@{5f515f7b24429831aaf4c9ec|full_name} I personally only really add notes on the players I block, I like to keep track of why I did, my block list is quite big as it includes some ppl with huge amounts of alts. I am reaching the 2k fast personally

As of August 2026, I'm still hitting this limit.

The error is now:

Update Player Notes Failed. You're not allowed to create more than 2369 user notes!

So the limit appears to have increased from around 2000/2099 to 2369, but it still exists. It would be great if the limit could be removed entirely, or at least increased significantly for long-time users and community organizers.

details:
I was editing a NOTE on a website and was told “You're not allowed to create more than 2000 user notesǃ”

I understand that you want to avoid adding millions of notes. However, this is very inconvenient when you are friends with more than 2000 players.

Even if you limit the number of player notes to 2000, please do not count at least your friends' player notes against this limit.

Webサイトでnoteを編集していたら、"You're not allow to create more than 2000 user notesǃ"と言われました。

何百万個もノートを付けることを避けたいのは理解します。ですが、2000以上のプレイヤーとフレンドである場合にこれはとても不便です。

player noteを2000個に制限をするにしても、少なくともフレンドのplayer noteについては、この制限数にカウントしないでほしい。
title: Stop limiting the number of player notes
